description: Token safety check — send a token contract, get a verdict (safe / caution / risky / avoid), a 0-100 score, risk level, red and green flags, a short summary, metrics (holders, top-10 share, LP locked, liquidity, 24h volume, pair age, taxes), a post-ready card and X/Twitter post counts. Checks honeypot, taxes, mint/pause/blacklist/fee powers, proxy, renounced owner. 8 chains. 404/free if no source knows the token; 503/free if the sources are down. Costs $0.01 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.

address.description: token contract (0x... on EVM chains, base58 mint on Solana)

name: token_verdict
